# New Epics

## Table Columns Spread Over Width of Table

Our most recent changes changed our column layouts so they no longer spread over the full width of the mat-table. Instead the only take up the width they need. We need to move this back to spreading over the full width of the table like they were before. I suspect the change was made during epic 20.

## Additional Code Review Items

Our Darkfactory process calls .github/instructions/review-story.md to do a code review on the resulting output of the changes for one of our stories. You should combine the review guidance from .github/instructions/code-review.md into review-story.md.

Also, we did an extensive code review recently using .github/epic-descriptions/epics-2026-11-13.md. You should also incorporate the spirit of that document into review-story.md so that our code continues to maintain the quality and standards we established during that review.
